title: Butkara Stupa
scope: Standing, excavated Great Stupa of Butkara I near Mingora, including the concentric masonry remnants and a selection of low votive bases in its immediate precinct.
limitations: Official precinct coordinate is the best available anchor for the Great Stupa centre. Move the model only if a better survey identifies that centre.
The model shows the excavated remains. Adjacent votive base placements, localized collapse, individual masonry and peripheral annexes are representative estimates.
No intact historical dome or sculptures are reconstructed. Separate Saidu Sharif I is outside the model scope.
next: Build the surviving nested circular base, schist paving and representative precinct remains.
